The independent Python fixture is generated from the unchanged pinned originals and contains 14 helpers, nine cold chains / 165 operations, 13 explicit direct components and two retained source exceptions. Native tests compare admitted results and complete projected state for both continuous owners and owners restored after every operation. All 51 focused tests and the transitive targeted typecheck pass in the postreview development receipt, with unchanged direct-input fingerprints; this predates integration of the effectively published lot 7A parent and is not its merged-source gate.

Malformed AFTER without entities is an explicit invalid-input difference: Python appends a command and then raises KeyError('entities'), leaving a partial inconsistent history, which the fixture preserves verbatim. Native ingress rejects that malformed observation with TypeError before mutation. An already retained partial BEFORE remains admitted when source record does not snapshot it. Neither exception is normalized into null or a successful acquired transition, and restoration is not weakened to admit the corrupted source history.

The source-compatible temporal API has no added search bound by default. Production opts into maximumNodes=65536 and maximumWork=2000000, with its current deadline and abort signal. A cutoff restores pre-proposal contact state and retains a current-bound unknown with frontier.complete=false, release_authority=false and block_unrelated_probe=true; it produces no action, learned impossibility or refutation.
